The vendor directly providing the **ZoomInfo** platform at **zoominfo.com** is **ZoomInfo Technologies Inc.** (operating through its principal operating subsidiary, **ZoomInfo Technologies LLC**).

### Provider Statements & Evidence:
* **Privacy Policy / Data Privacy Framework Notice:** ZoomInfo's official privacy documentation covering the platform at `zoominfo.com/legal/privacy-policy` states:
  > *"This Privacy Policy covers ZoomInfo Technologies Inc. and its subsidiaries and affiliates' practices (collectively, 'ZoomInfo') relevant to data processing generally, as well as processing specific to the ZoomInfo website and ZoomInfo products and services."*
* **SEC Disclosures:** In its SEC registration and annual filings, the company specifies:
  > *"ZoomInfo Technologies Inc. ... We maintain a website at www.zoominfo.com."*
* **TRUSTe Enterprise Privacy Certification:** TRUSTe identifies the certified operator covering `https://www.zoominfo.com` and its associated platform suites (ZoomInfo Sales, Marketing, Operations, Talent, etc.) as **ZoomInfo Technologies LLC**.
